details.description: Mistral 7B (v0.1) is Mistral AI's original 7-billion-parameter dense transformer language model, released in September 2023. It is a pretrained base model rather than an instruction-tuned chat model, using grouped-query attention and sliding-window attention, and Mistral's own model card states it outperforms Llama 2 13B on every benchmark the company tested. Mistral AI's models overview lists Mistral 7B (v0.1-v0.3) as deprecated since November 30, 2024 and retired since March 30, 2025, superseded by newer models such as Ministral 3 8B.
advantages: Mistral AI states Mistral 7B v0.1 outperforms Llama 2 13B on every benchmark the company tested, per its Hugging Face model card.
Uses grouped-query attention for faster inference and sliding-window attention to handle longer sequences at lower cost, per its Hugging Face model card.
Released under the Apache 2.0 license, permitting unrestricted commercial and private use.
disadvantages: Is a pretrained base model rather than an instruction-tuned chat model, and Mistral states it has no moderation mechanisms.

Mistral AI's models overview (docs.mistral.ai/getting-started/models/) lists Mistral 7B Instruct as deprecated and replaced by Ministral 3 8B, and lists Mistral 7B (v0.1-v0.3) with a deprecation date of November 30, 2024 and a retirement date of March 30, 2025.
use_cases: Base model for further fine-tuning into custom chat or task-specific models
General open-ended text generation and completion

notes: Catalog facts list max_input_tokens/max_output_tokens of 32768 with no deprecation_date; Fireworks' own model page (the host) states a 32.7k-token context window for this id, matching the catalog, so it was kept as-is. Mistral's own docs state the v0.1-v0.3 line is deprecated (11/30/2024) and retired (3/30/2025), which the catalog's empty deprecation_date does not reflect. An MMLU-Pro/GPQA auto-eval widget appeared on the Hugging Face page on one fetch but not on a repeat fetch of the same URL, so evaluations was left empty rather than risk an unreliable number.
